observation: Canonical orientation is healthy (h-ring correlation 0.986 and invariant pass), denoising retains 0.764 of points with a moderate 0.118 depth-NaN ratio, and detection returns the expected 10 prompts with regular x spacing. However, only 80% of prompts are real detections, two are assumed fallbacks, and the detected joint traces are visibly fragmented, especially in the lower-contrast left portion of the map.
failure_mode: Stage-4 f_missing_lines: intermittent or faint oblique joint evidence is not surviving binarization/Hough continuity requirements, forcing 20% fallback prompts and contributing to uneven SAM segment sizes and incomplete ring coverage.
rationale: Stages 1-3 are sufficiently healthy to avoid changing the locked unfolding or tunnel-specific radial band. A modestly lower binary and oblique Hough threshold, coordinated with a larger allowed oblique line gap, should reconnect faint fragmented joints and replace fallback prompts with measured intersections. Values remain conservative relative to the allowed bounds to limit spurious-line risk while preserving the already-correct ring count.
